messages:
morgan: starting a canary for tenant=420 in private/vpc. control plane shows intended split 10% -> 90% but agents are returning 'pending' on apply. console shows rollout as 'in-progress' (green). user traffic in traces show no canary hits. wtf? :thinking:

priya: can you paste the rollout id and agent versions? suspect older agent won't accept split-with-ack semantics.

morgan: rollout id r-2026-420, agents are on 2024.11. patch.0 (reported by inventory).

sam: found this in the private-agent log for one of the nodes:
```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z ERROR apply-config: config_validation_failed: unknown_field: "min_ack_count"
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z INFO current-hash: a3f5e7
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z INFO last-applied: 2026-03-18T13:58:02Z
```
looks like the control-plane sent the newer canary payload (we added min_ack_count) and the old agent just ignores it => marks pending.

deploy-bot: r-2026-420: canary apply started -> 10% (intended). 3 agents targeted, 0 acks.

leo: two axes of problem: (1) agent-schema mismatch (we need graceful downgrade on CP), (2) UX on console suggesting "green in-progress" while actually no agent ack. We should never show the rollout as healthy unless at least one agent acked or we have fallback routing.

dana: from an ops UX POV we need an explicit "ack count" and "age of last agent apply" in the rollout card. Right now the card only shows intended split + last updated. Suggest: show (intended / applied) numbers and a red badge when applied < intended for >30s.

priya: agree. proposal: control plane will include two fields when pushing to private clusters:
```json
{"split":0.1, "min_ack_count":1, "heartbeat_window_secs":120}
```
min_ack_count default 0 for backwards compat, but for private tenants we set to 1 so console doesn't lie. The agent should respond with apply_result {applied:true, hash:"..."}.

sam: downside: hitting old agents that ignore unknown fields will still not ack, so CP must treat missing ack as nack and surface it. I think we should also add an optimistic-local-fallback where the local proxy can apply split locally (best-effort) if CP ack doesn't arrive AND node has previously-verified image. But that complicates security for air-gapped setups.

leo: i'd prefer a conservative default: require explicit ack for canary traffic. Optimistic fallback should be opt-in per-tenant (and documented). For air-gapped regulated customers, we're not allowed to change traffic without explicit agent confirmation.

morgan: can we implement a short-term mitigation? this tenant needs the feature rolled out. options: (A) bump agent via a separate update then re-run, (B) set min_ack_count to 0 and rely on optimistic apply, (C) manually route a slice via gateway override.

priya: (A) safest. but agent update to private clusters takes time. (B) will make console inaccurate and might risk traffic hitting incompatible code. (C) manual route is possible for one tenant.

dana: if we go with (B) temporary, please put a clear warning in the console and in the rollout modal: "agent ack not received — intended split may not be applied on private nodes" + link to remediation. Ops will appreciate the transparency.

morgan: i'm going with (C) for now: manual gateway override to 10% on the edge for tenant 420 and pause control-plane canary. will open follow-up ticket to upgrade agents.

sam: created a short RFC for longer-term: add schema-negotiation in CP -> agent handshake, an "applied_split" metric emitted by agent (helpful for telemetry), and a console guard that flips rollout state to "blocked" when applied_count < min_ack_count after heartbeat_window_secs.

sam: RFC link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/rfc-agent-handshake-2026 (placeholder) :link:

deploy-bot: r-2026-420: manual edge override applied by morgan. rollout paused.

monitor-bot: alert: tenant=420 unusual-e2e: canary-misses increased from 0.2% -> 6% in last 3m.

morgan: thanks all. I'm filing the agent-upgrade ticket and a small console tweak for applied/intended numbers. I'll also add a quick note in the runbook about air-gapped tenants and min_ack_count behavior.

leo: one more ask — can we add a "why-stale" tooltip linking to last agent logs and the exact unknown-field error? Would save PMs and SEs time.

priya: yep, we can plumb the last agent error summary into the rollout status. will schedule for next sprint. :thumbsup:

morgan: ✅ paused, ticket #INC-7832 opened, will coordinate with SE to schedule agent update. thanks :wave:
